name: Do I need a permit for a tiny home build in San Marcos?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a tiny home build in San Marcos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, permits are typically required for tiny homes, even in areas like San Marcos. The specific types of permits needed will depend on whether your tiny home is considered a permanent dwelling, an accessory dwelling unit (ADU), or a recreational vehicle (if on wheels). Zen Tiny Homes assists clients in understanding and navigating the permitting process with local San Marcos authorities to ensure all regulations are met. It's crucial to confirm local zoning ordinances before starting any build.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are generally required for tiny homes in San Marcos, varying by type (permanent, ADU, or RV). Zen Tiny Homes assists with the permitting process.
